name: retriever-gate
command: uv run python -m evals.pageindex_gate --json --arm-a weaviate --arm-b pinecone --arm-b weaviate+rerank --arm-b pinecone+rerank
smoke_command: uv run python -m evals.pageindex_gate --json --smoke --stage 1 --arm-a weaviate --arm-b pinecone --arm-b weaviate+rerank --arm-b pinecone+rerank

stage1.select: best page_recall among passers, tie -> lower latency
